title: ABRAND
tagline: Making Hedge Fund accessible to everybody via crypto. HF raising LP onchain for offchain investing.
description:
ABRAND is the onchain hedge fund marketplace. Invest stablecoin USDC onto novel or proven strategies. No minimums, no lockups, instant settlement. Built on Arc Testnet. Possible thanks to a new oracle mechanism via chainlink.

1. **Discovery** — A curated fund marketplace (Bloomberg meets Robinhood, but darker). Users browse funds, read strategy docs, see track records.
2. **Trading** — Deposit USDC, receive vault shares at NAV. Redeem anytime, get USDC or a bank wire.
how_its_made:
Deposit USDC into ERC4626 vaults, get NAV-priced shares in actively managed funds. Auditor-signed NAV via EIP-712, redemption queues with dispute protection. Oracle is made through validation of the NAV by a trusted auditor. 


ARC is used to raise capital and transfer the USDC natively without fees to Coinbase. The hedge fund can open a subaccount there or withdraw the funds for other usage.

Chainlink is used as oracle, adapting NAV oracle to smaller funds, automating the process to accept any fund in clics. The auditor, the regulator who validates the NAV, sign onchain to validate the estimation given by the fund, when an automated oracle is not accessible.
auto_summary: An onchain hedge-fund marketplace using ERC4626-style vaults, auditor-signed NAV updates, a web frontend, and a separate Chainlink CRE workflow prototype.
